Scout, Marshal, Sapper, Signal Officer and Retriever use portraits by SakPix
from Cyberpunk Portrait Pack (Free Edition), distributed by the artist for use
in game projects. The author labels the pack as AI-assisted.

Author release: https://sakpix.itch.io/cyberpunk-portrait-pack-free-200-sci-fi-character-portraits

The five portraits were cropped from the user-supplied transparent sheets.
Scout: Cyberportraits transparent (12), row 1, column 1
Marshal: Cyberportraits transparent (8), row 2, column 3, trimmed left edge
Sapper: Cyberportraits transparent (8), row 1, column 1
Signal Officer: Cyberportraits transparent (12), row 2, column 4
Retriever: Cyberportraits transparent (18), row 2, column 2
